svg.title: Planned signal processing through RabbitMQ and a simulated broker
svg.desc: Planned integration. Proximtype is an example producer and is not integrated. The local flow will use a demo analytics application. Fictional broker: no real orders. Outbox publication, intake acknowledged after commit, signal rejection and dead-lettering at intake, signal evaluation, operator approval in manual execution mode, submission during a trading session, lapse and expiry at the end of signal validity, order cancellation, and signal outcome delivery through the outbox.

text.font-family: Consolas, Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

text.tspan: Planned integration. Proximtype is an example producer and is not integrated. The local flow will use a demo analytics application.
Fictional broker: no real orders. RabbitMQ transport. At-least-once delivery. Deduplication by id.

text.tspan: After a terminal order status, in a separate commit:
refused or lapsed → SignalDeclined | rejected → OrderRejected
filled → OrderFilled | expired → OrderExpired | cancelled → OrderCancelled
Intake is acknowledged at once. The outcome may follow hours or days later. Each processable message ends with exactly one signal outcome, correlated by id.
